comments.body:
From my own experience I would say Switzerland is pretty racist and old fashioned in their behaviour. Both humour and general beliefs are often over the line of what is accepted in other countries. 
When my husband and I bought our house here, the estate agent and seller were joking and laughing about the fact foreigners were coming to the village, but at least we were the right kind (we’re both from Northern European countries) my husband and I were horrified at the comments.
comments.author: InjuryElegant5024
